quotes: War Traveler

Replace your Gloves with Chain Gloves, Boots with War Traveler, and Helmet with Harlequin Crest to maximize Magic Find. Fill out your inventory with Charms that grant Magic Find and Resistances.

quotes: Andariel's Visage (ethereal, 15% IAS / 30% Fire Resist Jewel)
The Standard Blizzard Sorceress aims to reach the 105% FCR Breakpoint with as many +x to Skills, and -x% Enemy Cold Resistances in areas with Immune to Cold monsters.

Use Death's Fathom instead of Doom Double Axe while farming in any regular farming spot. The combination of Glacial Diadem of the Magus, and Ormus' Robes maximizes your damage. Nightwing's Veil + Skin of the Vipermagi is a great alternative to them. Trang-Oul's Claws Heavy Bracers, 2 Stone of Jordan Rings and Arachnid Mesh complete the setup with FCR and +x to Skills.

Might Aura Mercenary works well for extra damage against Cold Immunes. Insight Giant Thresher brings massive Mana Regeneration. Andariel's Visage, and Fortitude provide the remaining damage and survivability needed.
Cold Rupture breaks ALL Cold Immune monsters and brings them to 95% resistance. Pair this with Cold Mastery.
